## H3 · 스토리보드 A·B → 24.5초 영상 (Qwen 2.1 3×3 · Singularity v2)

**입력**: A·B 기준 이미지 각 1장. **출력**: 최종 24.5초(588f) 영상 1개 (A 12.25초(294f) → B 12.25초(294f) · 24fps · 무음 · H3 프레임 수 17k+5로 올림). A·B 스토리보드 시트는 미리보기.
- 9패널이 시간순으로 H3 <Picture 1>~<Picture 9> 참조로 연결 (원래 설계 유지).
- 제거: A·B 12.25초 클립 개별 저장(최종본에 포함), 패널별 미리보기 18개 + 비교 미리보기.
- ⚠ MiniMax H3 라이선스: 대한민국은 제외 지역.
- 출력 정리 (10/14): 패널별 저장·클립별 저장·비교 미리보기 수십 개 → **최종 영상만 저장**, 스토리보드 시트는 **미리보기**(파일로 안 쌓임).
- 생성형 파이프라인이라 원본 영상 정확 타겟 대상 아님. Qwen-Image 2.1 = 비상업 라이선스.

[검증] 로컬 ComfyUI(코어+LTXVideo+KJ+VHS 최신)에서 노드 스키마 검증 + 모델 단계를 대체한 전후처리 실행 검증 완료 (가로×세로·프레임 수·FPS·프레임 정렬·보호영역 픽셀). Cloud GPU 실제 생성은 미실행.

### 2026-10-23 · 모델 최신화
- H3 모델: Singularity **v1.3 Pruned INT8 → v2 INT8** (`Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_int8.safetensors` · 2026-10-21 공개 · 34.0GB, v1.3 Pruned 21GB보다 큼). 텐서 구조는 v1.3 일반 INT8과 동일 → 로더·샘플링 설정 그대로. Cloud 등록명 `WarmBloodAban__Minimax-h3_Singularity__Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_int8.safetensors` (가이드 4장대로 가져오기).
- 실제 GPU 렌더는 새 모델로 아직 안 돌림 — 같은 폴더의 결과 영상·대조시트는 이전 모델 기준.

nodes.title: A · 메카 드래곤 · Qwen 2.1 → MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
Create one continuous cinematic 12-second reference-to-video sequence as a silent video.

REFERENCE ROLES
<Picture 1> through <Picture 9> are nine chronological storyboard frames from one continuous sequence. Follow them in exact numerical order as the visual plan for the entire clip.
Treat all nine pictures together as the immutable identity, design, material, action, lighting, composition, and visual-style reference for the exact mecha dragon.
Preserve the exact same head, armor geometry, mechanical joints, wings, tail, glowing eyes, chest core, materials, proportions, and night-city atmosphere shown consistently across the pictures. Do not redesign or replace the dragon.

SHOT DIRECTION
0:00–0:03 — Storm-dark futuristic city in heavy rain. Slow low-angle push toward the dormant mecha dragon on a tower. Its red eyes and chest core ignite in sequence. Subtle neck pistons and jaw plates move with convincing mechanical weight.
0:03–0:06 — Smooth orbit as segmented wings unfold and displace rain and mist. Blue electrical arcs travel over wet armor. Keep the silhouette readable and every mechanical part stable.
0:06–0:09 — The dragon launches from the tower and accelerates between skyscrapers. Fast side-tracking camera, believable wing force and tail follow-through, background motion blur only.
0:09–0:12 — Frontal three-quarter shot. The core charges with blue-white electricity and the dragon releases one controlled lightning blast toward camera. End on a full-screen white flare with a red edge sweeping left-to-right for the transition into Part B.


HARD CONSTRAINTS
One dragon only. No humans. No additional creatures. No duplicate heads, wings, limbs, horns, or tails. No morphing, melting, identity drift, geometry flicker, random cuts, text, captions, logos, watermarks, or UI. Maintain coherent 16:9 cinematic framing and finish exactly on the white-and-red flare.

widgets_values:
Create one continuous cinematic 12-second reference-to-video sequence as a silent video.

REFERENCE ROLES
<Picture 1> through <Picture 9> are nine chronological storyboard frames from one continuous sequence. Follow them in exact numerical order as the visual plan for the entire clip.
Treat all nine pictures together as the immutable identity, face, costume, action, lighting, composition, and visual-style reference for the exact young red-suited hero.
Preserve the exact same face, age, hair, body proportions, red suit, chest emblem, gloves, boots, cape, materials, colors, rooftop, and night-city atmosphere shown consistently across the pictures. Do not redesign, mask, replace, or age the hero.

0:00–0:03 — Open on the matching full-screen white flare with a red edge sweeping left-to-right. It clears to reveal the hero on a rain-swept rooftop while distant blue lightning flickers. The hero turns toward the storm and the cape rises naturally in the wind.

0:06–0:09 — Pull to a low-angle full-body shot. The hero runs three believable strides and launches from the roof. Cape and clothing respond naturally to acceleration and wind.
0:09–0:12 — Wide aerial tracking between skyscrapers, then a frontal push-in. A restrained red energy wake meets the distant blue lightning without hiding the hero. End on a stable iconic three-quarter hover above the city, cape flowing.


HARD CONSTRAINTS
One hero only. No additional people, helmet, mask, weapons, armor, costume changes, body transformation, extra fingers, limbs, capes, faces, or emblems. No face distortion, identity drift, flicker, morphing, random cuts, text, captions, logos, watermarks, or UI. Maintain coherent 16:9 cinematic framing and end on the final hovering hero pose.

nodes.title: 2026-11-07 · 이번 수정 및 검증 범위
widgets_values:
## 이번 수정본
- 시드 randomize → fixed 2곳: 같은 조건 비교와 캐시 재사용. 새 변형은 시드를 변경.
- CreateVideo 구형 위젯 순서 3곳을 현재 5개 입력 규격에 맞춤.
- 영상 저장 설정 1곳 정규화: 일반 MP4 H.264 CRF18, 기존 CRF16/ProRes 유지. 배열·이름 저장값 동기화.

검증: JSON·연결·서브그래프 제어값 정적 검사. 이 파일의 GPU 생성·속도·화질 A/B는 미실행. 원문 안내에 적힌 과거 실행 성공/초 단위 수치는 이번 검증 결과가 아닙니다.

RTX PRO 6000도 긴 영상 전체 처리에서는 RAM/VRAM 부담이 큽니다. 1개 짧은 샷부터 확인하세요. 미리보기·추가 출력은 필요한 것만 실행하세요.

nodes.title: Qwen 편집 지시 + 네거티브 · 이미지 레퍼런스

replaces_original.title: 01 · A 스토리보드 디렉터 · Nano Banana 2 Lite

widgets_values:
REFERENCE-LOCKED 3×3 CINEMATIC STORYBOARD — PART A: THE MECHA DRAGON AWAKENS

Use the supplied image as the authoritative identity and style reference. Preserve the exact same mecha dragon: identical head silhouette, armor geometry, mechanical joints, scale, materials, color accents, glowing eyes, energy core, and every recognizable design detail. Preserve the reference image's rendering style, lighting language, atmosphere, and level of detail. Do not redesign, simplify, recolor, or replace the dragon.

OUTPUT LAYOUT
Create ONE clean 16:9 image containing an exact 3×3 contact sheet. Nine equal 16:9 panels arranged left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Every panel must fill its cell edge-to-edge. No gaps, borders, captions, numbers, labels, text, logos, watermarks, UI, or storyboard marks. Keep the same dragon and the same night city throughout all nine panels.

STORY PROGRESSION
PANEL 01 — Extreme wide establishing shot. A storm-dark futuristic city. The dormant mecha dragon is a massive silhouette on a tower while faint blue lightning gathers behind it.
PANEL 02 — Low-angle medium wide. The dragon raises its armored head; red eyes and chest core ignite through rain and mist.
PANEL 03 — Extreme macro close-up of the eye, jaw plates, exposed micro-mechanics, wet metal, and blue electrical arcs crawling across the armor.
PANEL 04 — Dynamic three-quarter shot. Mechanical wings unfold with powerful segmented motion; rain is blown outward by the force.
PANEL 05 — Hero-wide shot. The dragon launches from the tower, debris and blue lightning exploding beneath its claws.
PANEL 06 — Fast aerial tracking shot between skyscrapers. The dragon flies toward camera; wings and tail remain anatomically and mechanically consistent.
PANEL 07 — Dramatic frontal shot. The chest core charges; concentrated blue-white electricity coils around the jaw and torso.
PANEL 08 — Peak action. The dragon releases a controlled lightning blast across the night sky, illuminating the city without destroying the dragon's form.
PANEL 09 — Transition frame. The lightning expands into a full-screen white flare with a strong red edge sweeping left-to-right, designed as a clean match cut into Part B.

VISUAL DIRECTION
Cinematic science-fiction action, premium feature-film composition, deep blacks, electric blue lightning, restrained red accents, rain, mist, volumetric light, crisp metal detail, strong depth, coherent screen direction, and progressively rising energy. Use varied shot sizes while maintaining perfect subject continuity.

HARD CONSTRAINTS
Exactly one dragon in every applicable panel. No humans. No additional creatures. No costume changes. No duplicated limbs, wings, heads, horns, or tails. No deformed machinery. No unrelated objects. No text of any kind. The result must read as nine consecutive frames from one continuous film.
